mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity document of each proposed member (individual) and authorized signatory / legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or competent civil registry of the individual's home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization for documents issued abroad, followed by Vietnamese judicial notarization and certified translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening of all proposed members, UBOs, directors, managers and authorized signatories against: (i) domestic PEP and senior political exposure lists required by Articles 9-14 of Law 14/2022/QH14 and Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List (UNSCR 1267/1989 and 1718); (iii) OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists with attention to USD clearing rails; (iv) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; (v) Vietnamese Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) watchlist and State Bank of Vietnam administrative sanction data; and (vi) adverse media and global regulatory enforcement databases — records retained for at least 5 years post-cessation under Decree 107/2023/NĐ-CP.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Information System (Hệ thống Thông tin Quốc gia về Đăng ký Doanh nghiệp) – https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be rendered primarily in Vietnamese (accented Latin script per Vietnamese alphabet standards). The name sequence must comprise the entity type 'Công ty TNHH' (Limited Liability Company), a proper distinguishing name, and may incorporate a transliterated foreign element (e.g., the true international trade name of the SSP/AdTech parent). Foreign script is permissible only as a supplementary identifier after the Vietnamese name, must be non-confusing, and must not duplicate or be similar to any existing registered name as evaluated by the Department of Planning and Investment within the national uniqueness database. Numerals and legitimate symbols may appear only if not misleading as to the legal form or licensed activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Government-institutional tokens: 'Chính phủ', 'Nhà nước', 'Quốc hội', 'Thủ tướng', 'Bộ Công an', 'Quân đội nhân dân', 'Công an nhân dân' – express prior ministerial or State authority approval required; generally refused for private companies

Regulated financial tokens: 'Ngân hàng', 'Tổ chức tín dụng', 'Bảo hiểm', 'Chứng khoán', 'Quỹ đầu tư', 'Vàng bạc' – prior license from the State Bank of Vietnam or Ministry of Finance required before name clearance
Licensed professional tokens: 'Công chứng', 'Đấu giá', 'Thẩm định giá', 'Luật sư', 'Kiểm toán' – restricted to licensed practitioners and firms under sectoral law
Naming elements identical or confusingly similar to an already-registered enterprise in the national registration database
Names violating national traditions, ethics, customs, or containing vulgar, offensive or politically sensitive wording
Claims of ministerial, municipal, diplomatic, or sovereign status (e.g., 'Hoàng gia', 'Vua', flag or heraldic emblems) absent statutory authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the DPI rejects the proposed name, the applicant receives a written notice stating the statutory reason (Article 24, Law on Enterprises 2020; Article 16, Decree 47/2021/NĐ-CP). The applicant may (i) correct the proposed name and re-submit an amended enterprise registration dossier via the NERIS portal without penalty; or (ii) file an administrative complaint with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee within 30 days of the written refusal under Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13, and subsequently, if the complaint is denied or unanswered for more than 45 days, initiate an administrative court action in the competent Provincial People's Court under Law on Administrative Procedure No. 93/2015/QH13. A supplementary fresh name reservation and pre-clearance search using the NERIS proposed-name checker is strongly recommended prior to appeal to avoid further delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered address. Law on Enterprises 2020 and Decree 47/2021/NĐ-CP require the LLC to maintain a physical registered office in Viet Nam at an identifiable address (street, building floor if applicable, ward/district/city) legally available for receipt of service of process and statutory correspondence. A serviced or virtual address may be used only as a supplementary correspondence point; the DPI and tax authority require proof of legal use of the physical premises. For a low-risk programmatic AdTech SSP (no special advertising license), a commercial co-working lease satisfies the statutory mandate if the lease agreement, premise-owner consent, and certificate of head-office right-to-use are submitted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate risk. Based on provincial DPI and General Department of Taxation enforcement statistics for foreign-invested LLCs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, unannounced on-site inspections occur with approximately 30% probability within the first 36 months of active operation, concentrated in tax registration verification, VAT refund audits, and AML record-compliance checks; because the AdTech SSP operates with no ministerial license and processes cross-border payments, the local tax authority may verify head-office existence before approving transfer-pricing and VAT credit applications.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign investor corporate document legalization – Apostille or Consular Legalization of 5-document set (Certificate of Incorporation, financial statements, POA, bank letters, passports)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Consular Department) and/or competent Apostille authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Circular No. 120/2017/TT-BTC on consular and legalization fees; origin-country apostille fees per applicable schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese translation and public notarization of the legalized corporate document set
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed certified translation service provider and Provincial Notary Public Office (Phòng Công chứng)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary fee schedule set by Provincial People's Committee; translation at prevailing Hanoi/HCMC certified translator market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) dossier assembly, English/Vietnamese dual-language application, and DPI pre-submission consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) and external counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: IRC issuance is exempt from government fee; professional consultation and dossier preparation at market benchmark rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) filing, national name-clearance search, and NERIS e-submission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) through the National Enterprise Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory government application fee for ERC; service fee for assisted e-filing and name verification at attorney rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal (official chop) engraving and sample-seal notification to DPI under Decree 99/2016/NĐ-CP regime
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed seal-engraving vendor; DPI electronic sample-seal registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Seal registration and notification fee is statutory-free; engraving cost at market rate (VND 600,000–1,500,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory public notice of enterprise establishment and charter summary on the National Enterprise Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National Enterprise Registration Information System operator (Ministry of Planning and Investment)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Service fee schedule under Decree 47/2021/NĐ-CP and Ministry of Planning and Investment tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and sanctions screening of all shareholders, UBOs (natural persons), directors and authorized signatories against UNSC, OFAC, EU/UK and Vietnamese domestic lists via commercial KYC database
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial KYC/AML screening database vendor under engagement by external counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial subscription and per-record search benchmark for corporate UBO due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP status determination, source-of-funds interview documentation, and enhanced due diligence memorandum for non-resident investor's directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark senior associate hourly rate (USD 350–500 per hour) for structured EDD work product

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation regulatory memo on AdTech/SSP and programmatic advertising scope under Law on Advertising No. 16/2012/QH13, Decree No. 181/2013/NĐ-CP (as amended) and Personal Data Protection Decree No. 13/2023/NĐ-CP, confirming absence of special licensing requirement for ISIC 7310
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel / licensed law firm (international practice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee regulatory opinion at prevailing international-firm market rate in Hanoi/HCMC

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises of Viet Nam No. 59/2020/QH14, as amended, principally Articles 25, 27-30, 40, 47, 50, 54, 74, 112-115, 122 and 132; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37-40 and 44; Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP on enterprise registration; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT prescribing business registration forms; Decree No. 122/2021/NĐ-CP on registration fee rates.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment, acting through the National Business Registration Portal (dkdn.gov.vn), and the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally run city where the head office of the company is situated.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Enterprise Registration Application (Form Phụ lục I-1 of Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT) accompanied by the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) and List of Members (Phụ lục I-6); for a foreign-invested LLC, the Investment Project Proposal and the Investment Registration Application submitted under the Law on Investment form part of the consolidated dossier.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to the establishment of a non-conditional programmatic advertising exchange and SSP platform LLC. Under Articles 112-113 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, the charter capital is determined freely by the members, and every member must contribute the full amount of registered capital within ninety days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. No state escrow or prescription of a special contribution bank account is mandated, but capital contributions are evidenced by bank transfer records and a capital contribution schedule appended to the charter.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY — ADOPTED BY WRITTEN CONSENT OF ALL MEMBERS ON [DATE]

The undersigned Members constituting 100% of the charter capital of [Company] Co., Ltd. (the "Company"), acting pursuant to Chapter V and Articles 74 and 132 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, hereby adopt the following resolutions:

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The Members unanimously approve the charter capital of VND [amount] and the capital contribution subscriptions set out in the List of Members. The Chairperson of the Members' Council is directed to open a company bank account and to ensure that all capital contributions are fully paid by each Member within ninety (90) days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The registered office of the Company is adopted as the permanent headquarters address at [full street address, ward, district, province], Viet Nam. The registered office shall be the exclusive statutory address for all state correspondence, tax notices, and legal service of process.

3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The Members appoint [Name] as Chairman of the Members' Council, [Name] as General Director, and [Name] as the Company's legal representative, with full authority to sign statutory filings, execute commercial contracts, open bank accounts, and perform all procedural acts before the enterprise registration, investment, tax, and licensing authorities.

4. EFFECTIVE DATE. These resolutions are effective immediately and are binding on all Members, officers, and subsequent shareholders without any further approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate for Foreign-Owned LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the target province/centrally run city, or the National Foreign Investment One-Stop Portal (dangky dau tu) of the Ministry of Planning and Investment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a foreign-invested LLC, file an Investment Project Proposal together with the Investment Registration Application through the online National Investment Information System. Attach corresponding legal entity documents, a lease or site-use deed, and evidence of financial capacity. The DPI will issue an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) after legal review; certain projects not subject to investment policy approval may obtain the IRC concurrently with the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) under a combined application procedure.
required_dossiers: Investment Registration Application form (Phụ lục II-1 of Decree 31/2021/NĐ-CP)
Investment Project Proposal including scope, location, size, and planned capital
Legal status papers of the foreign investor (certificate of incorporation, bylaws, annual financial statements or bank guarantee)
Notarized lease agreement or land-use right documents for the proposed office
Financial capacity statement or bank confirmation of funds
Power of attorney if applicant is not the direct investor
Copy of the passport or ID of the legal representative (if individual)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request to supplement or clarify, the investor must respond with complete documents within ten working days; a refusal or rejection may be appealed to the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee or litigated at the relevant administrative court under the Law on Administrative Procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Approve Company Charter and Capital Schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Members' Council of the company (private constitutive act), optionally assisted by a licensed notary public for notarized signatures and certified translations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding members execute the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), the List of Members, the capital contribution schedule, and the initial meeting minutes. The Charter must comply with Article 29 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and contain the company's enterprise name, head office address, charter capital, share proportions, legal representative details, and decision-making procedures. Notarization is optional but commonly performed; signatures of foreign members may require consular legalization or apostille and certified Vietnamese translation.
required_dossiers: Company Charter in Vietnamese language
List of charter members with capital contributions
Capital contribution schedule
Minutes and written resolutions of the first Members' Council meeting
Consular or apostilled ID/incorporation documents of members (where applying company officer)
Notarized Vietnamese translation of each foreign document (if notarization elected)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary refuses or if the content is inconsistent with mandatory legal provisions, the members may revise the charter and re-execute it in a subsequent signatory round, or seek judicial ratification of the founders' resolution by a court of competent jurisdiction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Enterprise Registration Application with National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (dkdn.gov.vn) under the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment; provincial DPI responsible for the selected location.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the National Business Registration Portal using an enterprise digital certificate or a confirmatory account, fill the Enterprise Registration Application (Form I-1), upload all required PDF dossiers, sign with a digital signature, pay the registration fee online, and submit. The registration officer verifies formal conditions and may issue a Certificate of Business Registration Input Confirmation or a completeness request. Once accepted, the system forwards the dossier to the relevant DPI.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Application (Electronic form)
Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty)
List of Members with capital contributions
Investment Registration Certificate (or combined IRC/ERC application references)
Valid identity papers (passport or national ID) of the legal representative and each individual member/corporate member's authorized representative
Certificate of incorporation and appointment of authorized representative for corporate members
Office lease or deed proving the right to use the registered address
Form for registration of company seal style (if used)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a query or rejection under Article 27 of Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP, the applicant has ten working days to supplement and resubmit; failure to respond leads to rejection of the dossier. Re-submission after cure is processed as a new application, subject to the same three-day turnaround.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Enterprise Registration Certificate and Automatic Tax Code
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment and the General Department of Taxation (via the national integrated tax database)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, the DPI issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) in electronic form with a unique enterprise tax identification number. The ERC contains the company's legal status, tax code, and governing registration record; no separate application is required for the tax code because the national database synchronizes with the State Tax Registry. The Company should download and preserve the electronic certificate and, where requested, obtain a physical copy with an official seal.
required_dossiers: Receipt of completed enterprise registration dossier acknowledgment
Proof of payment of the enterprise registration fee
No further paper dossiers are required; the ERC is delivered ex officio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of an error in the ERC (name, address, members, or capital), the company must apply for correction through the National Business Registration Portal using Form I-8 within ten working days; refusal to correct can be administratively appealed to the Agency for Business Registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Create Company Seal, Open Bank Account, and Complete Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company management; commercial bank where the transaction account is opened; the DPI for seal sample notification (done online after seal creation); tax authority for bank account registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, the Company may create a company seal in any design lawfully chosen under Article 137 of the Law on Enterprises. The seal sample must be declared by filing a notice of seal sample online with the DPI and the tax authority. The Company then opens a bank account and instructs each member to transfer statutory capital contributions. Each contribution must be recorded in the capital contribution register and evidenced by a bank credit confirmation. The General Director shall cause registration of the bank account details in the tax portal under the Tax Administration Law.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Company Charter
Seal sample declaration form
Identification of the legal representative
Bank account opening form and KYC documents
Capital contribution payment vouchers and bank certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If capital contribution is not fully paid within ninety days, the Company must adjust the charter capital or the membership ratios in the internal records and register the change; overdue contribution may trigger civil liability of the defaulting member and revision of ERC data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register Tax Obligations and License Fee Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direct Tax Department / local tax office of the provincial Tax Administration; General Department of Taxation online portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon ERC issuance, the obligation to file an initial license fee (môn bài) declaration arises if the projected revenue exceeds VND 500,000,000 per year. The company should register for VAT (subject to the credit method or a simplified method after consultation with the tax office), set up payroll tax registration (if hiring employees), and adopt a fiscal accounting regime under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC. Use the e-tax portal to file the entity registration and fee declaration online.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Tax registration declaration automatically populated via National Business Registration Portal
License fee declaration form (mẫu 01/LPMB and 02/LPMB, if applicable)
Company seal sample
Bank account confirmation
Accounting policy or appointment of accountant/chief accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the company misses an initial license fee declaration, it may file a late declaration with late-payment interest of 0.03% per day and seek reduction of the penalty under Article 59 of the Tax Administration Law No. 38/2019/QH14; for substantive errors, a corrective declaration (khai bổ sung) can be lodged electronically.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Workplace Fire Safety and Occupational Clearance (if premises are in the statutory list)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Fighting Police, Fire Prevention and Fighting Police Department, Ministry of Public Security; local construction inspection authority for structural premises.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Evaluate whether the office is subject to the mandatory fire safety appraisal list under Decree No. 136/2020/NĐ-CP: high-rise buildings, buildings accommodating more than 200 people, or facilities classified as a group II to group IV fire danger. If the premises falls within the list, the Company must submit a fire safety design dossier and obtain the Fire Prevention and Fighting Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt phòng cháy chữa cháy) before commencing work. If the premises is a standard commercial office where the building owner holds the relevant certificates, the Company shall file a written declaration of fire-safety arrangements and, if needed, request a site inspection.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Lease agreement or building ownership document
Architectural floor plan and site plans
Fire safety design dossier or owner's fire safety certificate
Technical declaration of the premises' electrical and egress systems
List of fire extinguishers and records of inspection/maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire police refuse to issue a certificate, the Company must remedy fire-protection deficiencies within the prescribed period and reapply for serial re-inspection; an administrative appeal may be filed within 30 days of the refusal under Article 23 of the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not directly applicable to a programmatic ad exchange/SSP platform because the activity is strictly office-based and does not constitute a manufacturing, processing, or industrial operation. Should any ancillary physical warehouse or equipment site be established, the competent authority would be the Provincial Department of Industry and Trade (Sở Công Thương) and the management board of the industrial or technical zone where the site is located.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating licence or ad-platform licence is required under Vietnamese law for programmatic real-time advertisement exchange and SSP services. The Company's lawful authorization to operate is derived from the Investment Registration Certificate (if foreign-owned) and the Enterprise Registration Certificate, together with ordinary bookkeeping and tax registration. If advertising agency work is performed as a separate business line, a general business registration extension may be required but not a dedicated ad license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) / Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) — Environmental Protection Licensing Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from the full environmental impact assessment (EIA) obligation because the business is an information-service and data-processing enterprise without manufacturing lines, wastewater-intensive processes, or large industrial installations. The activity falls under the non-generating waste/emissions category; at most, the Company must register its small-source wastewater and solid-waste management plan with the nearest DONRE if it generates domestic wastewater above the domestic household threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any incidental domestic wastewater, the Company must observe QCVN 14-MT:2015/BTNMT (domestic wastewater parameters) where a direct discharge to municipal sewer exists; for office ventilation and air-conditioning emissions, note that no VOC or NOx monitoring applies, but compliance with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT on industrial exhaust air should be ensured if any diesel standby generator is placed on-site. All electronic equipment and disposable materials will be treated as ordinary non-hazardous municipal waste; any used batteries or electronic waste from IT operations must be collected and handed to a licensed recycler under Decree No. 08/2022/NĐ-CP.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the provincial fire police must be obtained if the leased office is located in a building classified as a group II or higher danger facility or if the workforce exceeds the applicable headcount threshold (typically 200 persons or more). The Company must also secure a structural load clearance from the building owner/certified engineer if any server rack or heavy equipment is installed in the premises, as well as a workplace inspection certificate confirming adequate egress, emergency lighting, first-aid availability, and occupational health compliance under Circular 19/2016/TT-BYT. In practice, for a conventional office lease in a certified commercial tower, the Company obtains a letter of confirmation from the building management confirming that the existing fire certificate, structural load rating, and evacuation plans cover the leased floor.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế, GDT), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; day-to-day administration is exercised by the provincial Department of Taxation of Hanoi/Ho Chi Minh City where the LLC is headquartered. Official e-portals: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (domestic e-tax filing and e-invoice subsystem) and https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn (national tax web portal used for Foreign Contractor Tax, cross-border supplier registration, and payment settlement).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC must complete the following sequence: (1) obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or the Industrial/Export-Processing Zone Authority after filing the investment project application (15 working days statutory review); (2) register the enterprise with the provincial Business Registration Office to obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); (3) the 10-digit/13-digit Tax Identification Number (MST, mã số thuế) is automatically assigned by the National Business Registration Database upon issuance of the ERC, with data electronically shared to the GDT, thereby completing CIT/VAT registration (an LLC does not file a separate paper tax-registration application); (4) using the MST, obtain a GDT-certified digital signature (USB token), register the e-invoice account and VAT declaration schedule on https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; (5) open a direct investment capital account and a current VND/FX bank account at a licensed commercial bank, and notify the tax office of the account; (6) for any payment to a non-resident ad-exchange/DSP/SSP counterparty, the local LLC must first register the foreign party under the Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) regime via https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn so that withholding VAT and CIT can be remitted correctly.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Vietnamese LLC is a resident enterprise subject to Corporate Income Tax (CIT) at the standard 20% rate on worldwide income; there is no pass-through or S-corporation style classification; dividends distributed by the LLC to foreign corporate shareholders are exempt from dividend withholding tax (the prior remittance tax was abolished in 2014), while a 5% personal income tax applies to distributions to resident individual shareholders; non-resident persons without an LLC establishment are subject to Vietnam-source taxation through Foreign Contractor Tax and are taxed on a territorial basis.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam has no U.S.-style check-the-box election and no elective OECD hybrid-mismatch rule. Statutory elections available to an LLC include: (1) VAT method election — the credit (input-deduction) method on a contractual/turnover basis instead of the direct/imputed-ratio method (the credit method is mandatory for enterprises with full accounting records and revenue above 10 billion VND, and optional for smaller firms); (2) CIT incentive election — selecting the investment regime (high-tech zone, geographic investment support areas, or large-scale projects) that is evidenced in the IRC to obtain a 10% or 15% CIT rate for 10–30 years, with a 4–9-year tax holiday; (3) Foreign Tax Credit election — under Circular 151/2014/TT-BTC, claiming a credit for foreign income tax paid on foreign-source income instead of a deduction; (4) group loss-offset is not elective; there is no consolidated tax-payroll regime, except statutory tax-loss carry-forward upon merger/consolidation (5 years). Hybrid arrangement deductions are denied or recharacterized by the transfer-pricing substance rules of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; no separate election exists to legitimately use a hybrid mismatch.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Law on Value Added Tax No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Laws 71/2014/QH13, 106/2016/QH13, 03/2017/QH14, and most recently Law No. 48/2024/QH15 effective 1 July 2025; implementing legislation includes Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC. Standard headline rate 10%, reduced 5% for essential goods/services; a temporary 2-percentage-point reduction (to 8%) applies to certain eligible goods/services through 30 June 2025 under Decree 180/2024/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Zero for corporate enterprises: a foreign-invested LLC must be VAT-registered from its first day of legal existence irrespective of turnover, and must file VAT declarations monthly (turnover above 50 billion VND/year) or quarterly (turnover at or below 50 billion VND/year), including nil returns during the pre-revenue stage. Non-resident suppliers of digital/ad-tech services without a domestic establishment must register for Foreign Contractor Tax via https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn from the first Vietnamese-source receipt; the turnover exemptions (100,000,000 VND/year for households/individuals, raised to 200,000,000 VND/year under Law 48/2024/QH15) do not apply to LLCs or registered enterprises.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All enterprises must issue electronic invoices (hóa đơn điện tử) under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP effective 1 July 2022, using GDT-certified software or certified e-invoice service providers integrated via API to the GDT e-invoice system at https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn. Every invoice data record must be transmitted to the GDT within 24 hours of issuance. Standard B2B invoices do not require a physical seal, but must contain a digital signature and QR code, and the GDT validates the record and returns an acceptance/error acknowledgment. Taxpayers classified as high-risk, newly formed, or using point-of-sale/cash-register e-invoices must obtain a pre-issued tax-authority code (mã của cơ quan thuế) generated in near-real-time via the API before the invoice is legally delivered. POS/retail transaction data is required to be transmitted synchronously to the GDT in phases from 1 September 2023 through 2024. Failure to transmit within the mandated window is treated as failure to issue an invoice, with penalty up to 20,000,000 VND per occurrence and forced use of pre-coded invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on exported ad-tech services is claimable under Article 9 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC only when all of the following are cumulatively established: (i) the programmatic advertisement/SSP/DSP platform services are supplied to a foreign contracting party (foreign advertiser, foreign ad agency, or foreign ad exchange) under a written service contract; (ii) the services are physically consumed outside Vietnam — evidenced by ad-server logs, publisher geolocation data, campaign delivery reports, and the absence of Vietnamese user impressions; (iii) payment is received from abroad via a licensed Vietnamese bank in convertible foreign currency and is repatriated within the statutory deadline; and (iv) the services are not on the prohibited list and are not considered domestic intermediary advertising (advertising services that sell goods/services to Vietnamese audiences are domestic supply at 10%). If the platform sells impressions to Vietnamese publishers or local advertisers, the fees attributable to that Vietnamese inventory are domestic revenue at 10% and must be recorded in separate invoices from the zero-rated offshore revenue. When 0% applies, the LLC is entitled to input VAT credits and refunds for VAT incurred on costs directly attributable to the export turnover, and refund claims are prioritized semi-annually/annually under Article 72 of Law 38/2019/QH14.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export-service e-invoice (0% VAT rate line; distinctive export invoice notation)
Written service contract with the foreign ad exchange/SSP/DSP/agency partner containing the export-consumption clause and payment terms
Service delivery certificate / ad-server campaign performance logs evidencing the audience impressions and usage outside Vietnam
Foreign buyer's certificate of tax residence or business registration / trade registry excerpt
Bank inward remittance certificate (SWIFT MTN / foreign exchange voucher) showing receipt of payment from the foreign buyer through a licensed Vietnamese bank
Customs export declaration and bill of lading — required only if tangible goods (e.g., ad-tech hardware/media kits) are bundled; for pure digital services, these are not applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT and the State Bank of Vietnam cross-check e-invoice zero-rated declarations with FX inflow records and CIT returns. If an auditor recharacterizes the invoice as a domestic advertising service (e.g., the campaign actually reached Vietnamese users, or the foreign contract is found to be artificial or back-to-back), the full turnover is re-taxed at 10% VAT, input VAT refunds already obtained are clawed back, and penalties apply: (1) an administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount (or 20% of the understated tax for non-fraudulent bookkeeping errors); (2) late-payment interest at 0.03% per day retroactive to the original due date; (3) forfeiture or suspension of CIT/VAT incentive treatment for the audited period; (4) criminal liability under Penal Code Article 200 for tax evasion where the evaded/fraudulently refunded amount exceeds 100,000,000 VND — individuals face fines up to 4,500,000,000 VND and/or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years; the commercial legal entity faces fines up to 10,000,000,000 VND and suspension of operations for up to 3 years; and (5) administrative coercion measures, forced disclosure of the violation on the GDT portal, and mandatory use of pre-coded tax-authority invoices for 12–24 months.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam) and its Foreign Exchange Administration
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime with a partially convertible capital account. Current account transactions, including cross-border payments for software, advertising, royalties, management fees and short-term trade credit, are convertible in practice through SBV-licensed credit institutions, provided the underlying transaction is supported by documentation and the account-holding bank is able to record the transaction under the balance-of-payments reporting framework. Capital account transactions are not freely convertible: inbound equity/debt contributions, outbound portfolio investment, intercompany loans and any remittance affecting the assets or liabilities of an FDI enterprise require registration with the SBV or the account-holding bank, a valid Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and a capital contribution schedule. Profit remittance is permitted only after the annual financial statements are audited, corporate income tax and other fiscal liabilities are settled, and the lawful distributable profit has been determined. Remittance may be made in one or several instalments during the fiscal year, but each remittance must be effected through the foreign currency account and cannot exceed the audited distributable profit net of statutory appropriations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a foreign-invested LLC, there is no mandatory percentage sale of export proceeds to a local bank under current law. However, 100% of export and service export proceeds, including advertising and programmatic platform receipts invoiced to foreign clients, must be repatriated to the entity's foreign currency account held with an SBV-licensed authorised credit institution within 180 days from the date of customs clearance for goods, or from the service completion/collection date for advertising services. Export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency and used for lawful foreign currency payments without prior conversion, but retaining such proceeds in a bank account outside Viet Nam requires individual SBV approval. Non-compliance can lead to administrative sanctions, suspension of foreign exchange purchase rights and adverse treatment in the bank's compliance rating.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account, Foreign Currency Operating Account, VND Operating Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMI accounts such as Airwallex, Wise Business, Revolut Business and Payoneer are not SBV-licensed credit institutions and cannot serve as the primary treasury or legal settlement account for a Vietnamese foreign-invested LLC. They cannot hold statutory capital, receive FDI equity injection, provide official balance-of-payments reporting, or grant direct access to local clearing systems such as NAPAS. They may be used only as supplementary collection conduits for foreign clients where the entity's bank of record is still a Vietnamese licensed bank, and funds must be consolidated into the local account promptly. Using an offshore EMI as the treasury account creates significant FX conversion, tax reporting and SBV compliance risk for the Brazilian entity and must be avoided for capital contributions and profit repatriation exercises.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory at the chosen domestic bank branch for the legal representative and usually the authorised signatories during account opening. Under SBV AML/CFT regulations, remote-only onboarding is not permitted for an FDI LLC; video or electronic KYC may supplement but cannot replace the in-person interview and original/notarised document review. For capital accounts requiring FX administration endorsement, the bank will sign the capital account agreement and require the presence of the authorised officers designated in the IRC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: recent or first-time capital contribution involving an undefined source of funds from a non-resident corporate shareholder located outside a FATF-equivalent jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised English translation of the shareholder's certificate of incorporation; register of directors; board resolution approving the investment and capital schedule; audited financial statements for the last two fiscal years; and a detailed source-of-wealth statement signed by each ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: ultimate beneficial ownership chain contains multiple intermediate shell or holding companies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate organisational chart with shareholding percentages; authenticated and apostilled corporate certificates for every holding layer; valid passports for all ultimate beneficial owners; beneficial ownership declarations; and an explanatory memorandum describing the commercial rationale for each intermediary company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: programmatic ad-tech business model involves receiving revenue from a concentration of foreign DSP/SSP platforms and immediate onward disbursement to media suppliers, which may be misclassified as payment-clearing or financial intermediary activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master services agreements and platform schedules with each counterparty; bank reference letter; documented billing/invoicing flow; sample SSP/DSP transaction lifecycle; list of direct media clients and publishers; revenue recognition policy; and a legal opinion confirming the company is a technology service provider and not a money services business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: regular high-volume outbound wires to countries or counterparties not previously notified to the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Projected disbursement schedule aligned with signed commercial contracts; global customer/supplier KYC dossier; third-party sanctions/AML screening report; payroll, tax and administrative outlay budget; and letters from counterparties confirming the business purpose of the transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: profit remittance or intercompany loan inscription requested before the initial audited balance sheet is available.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Interim management accounts; audited or compiled financial statements of the parent; IRC with registered capital; full capital contribution proof; Vietnamese tax clearance certificate; and the capital account agreement reflecting lawful use of the foreign currency account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders wire charter capital via SWIFT MT103 for direct remittance, or MT202 through a correspondent bank, to the entity's Foreign Direct Investment Capital Account opened at the domestic bank. The remitter must reference the company's IRC number and statutory contribution schedule. The bank records the transaction under SBV's balance-of-payments purpose code for direct investment equity contribution and validates it against the registered capital plan. Each inflow must be accompanied by a shareholder board resolution, source-of-funds evidence and a copy of the IRC/ERC. Once credited to the capital account, funds may be converted to VND for operating expenditures using the bank's daily exchange rate; the capital account may not be used for general payments unless conversion is permitted by SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN. After the bank's FX and AML review, funds are released to the operational account in VND or USD as required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For programmatic ad-tech SSP/DSP operations, outbound trade settlements are cleared by SWIFT MT103 for supplier and publisher payments and by NAPAS ACH transfers for local VND disbursements. Commercial letters of credit are not used for digital services; instead, the company uses prepayment, open-account netting and evergreen SWIFT wires to foreign platforms. For the US leg, the clearing path uses the entity's USD operating account with the Vietnamese bank, the bank's US correspondent, and the receiving aggregator/bank account. Outbound wires must include accurate balance-of-payments purpose codes, retain FX hedging contracts if applicable, and be supported by contracts and invoices in the bank's treasury compliance file. Periodic netting between the Vietnam entity and foreign subcontractors may be implemented only with complete bilateral contracts and timely supporting invoices to avoid SBV recharacterisation as a current-account advance or hidden capital transfer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX forwards for underlying trade and current account receivables/payables, entered into with SBV-licensed credit institutions and aligned with the actual payment cycle
FX swaps (sell-buy swaps) with licensed banks to manage short-term VND/USD liquidity mismatches on capital and operating accounts
Cross-currency swaps for hedge accounting on medium-term intercompany loans or material asset acquisitions, subject to bank approval and underlying proof
European-style currency options purchased from licensed banks to hedge unpredictable foreign currency exposure from global ad-platform revenue

Offshore NDFs are not permissible as onshore regulated instruments; treasury must avoid entering into non-deliverable contracts in the name of the Vietnam entity without SBV approval, and should instead use onshore forwards or parent-entity hedges where not locally prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Tax Return and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) via the District Tax Office of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid amount; administrative penalty of up to 1-3 times the unpaid license tax; enforced collection measures including bank-account freeze and suspension of export-import customs clearance after 90 days of arrears

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Form 03/TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) via the national e-Tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year (no later than 31 March for a calendar-year LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines from VND 2 million to VND 25 million under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; daily late-payment interest of 0.03% on any underpaid tax; enforced recovery and administrative strike-off if filing is omitted for a full tax year

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax Finalization Return (Form 05/QTT-TNCN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) via the national e-Tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year (no later than 31 March for a calendar-year LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines from VND 2 million to VND 25 million; daily interest of 0.03% on under-withheld PIT; back-up withholding assessment and tax-inspection exposure on payroll records

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Submission (Báo cáo tài chính năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance / GDT District Tax Office and the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year (no later than 31 March for a calendar-year LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from VND 2 million to VND 30 million depending on delay duration under Decree 41/2018/ND-CP; repeat violations trigger suspension of invoice issuance, sealing of accounting books, and mandatory compliance audits

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the registered head-office location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year (no later than 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine from VND 5 million to VND 10 million under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP; two consecutive years of non-filing and unreachability at the registered address trigger enterprise strike-off under Articles 211-213 of Law on Enterprises 2020

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Implementation Report (foreign-invested LLC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Registration Authority - provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year (no later than 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP and escalation to suspension of the Investment Registration Certificate for persistent non-reporting

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit every fiscal year for all foreign-invested enterprises, including 100% foreign-owned LLCs, irrespective of size under Decrees 17/2012/ND-CP and 211/2013/ND-CP; audit is also compulsory if charter capital exceeds VND 50 billion, if required by sectoral law, or if the LLC consolidates financial statements within a parent group
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; statutory annual financial statements must be prepared under VAS, audited by an independent licensed CPA firm, and expressed in VND; IFRS may be adopted solely as supplementary reporting

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam maintains no standing annual UBO registry return; the LLC must keep its Register of Members continuously accurate and file member-change notifications with the provincial DPI within 10 days of any share transfer or capital change; the annual enterprise information report and audited financial statements filed with the DPI restate the member and ownership structure, serving as the annual ownership confirmation; the Law on Money Laundering 2022 separately requires the enterprise to identify and retain records of beneficial owners for transactions, but does not create an annual UBO declaration filing
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên) for the LLC
Register of Directors/Executive Managers (Sổ quản lý người quản lý doanh nghiệp)
Original Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp)
Minute Book of Members' Resolutions and General Meetings
Company seal management register and specimen-signature records
Statutory accounting ledgers and transaction journals

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500-2,000 per year for a registered commercial address and corporate-secretarial or legal-agency service in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000-5,000 per year for a mid-sized foreign-invested LLC with standard ISIC 7310 advertising-revenue operations; USD 6,000-10,000 when group consolidation or intercompany transfer-pricing documentation is attached

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Foreign invested enterprises engaged in high-tech, software production, or new-technology business lines may qualify for a preferential CIT rate of 10% for 15 years, with an additional 50% reduction for the following 9 years or extended exemptions; programmatic advertising and SSP platform services generally do not qualify unless the entity obtains a High-Tech Enterprise certificate and meets revenue and R&D expenditure thresholds. Small and medium enterprises with annual revenue below VND 3 billion and registered capital paid up within a prescribed limit may apply a 4% to 5% reduced CIT rate for the first two years of operation. No general statutory tax holiday is available solely for foreign-owned LLCs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 03/TNDN (Corporate Income Tax Finalisation Return) filed via the General Department of Taxation's electronic portal (https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) using the Tax Database (TMS) system; quarterly provisional declarations are lodged on Form 01/TNDN via the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalisation return with quarterly provisional CIT payments and declarations
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual CIT finalisation return must be filed within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year; quarterly provisional returns and tax payments are due by the 30th day of the first month of the following quarter. Any residual tax liability must be fully settled by the finalisation deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, tax code (MST), address, tax period, and authorised signatory details of the foreign-invested LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident investors must ensure the LLC's Vietnamese tax code is correctly stated; the LLC itself is the resident taxpayer even if all members are foreign.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from programmatic advertising exchange services, including SSP platform fees, clearinghouse commissions, and data management service fees, recognised under Vietnamese accounting standards (VAS).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Revenue must be reconciled with transfer pricing documentation and cash flows from foreign parent or affiliate demand-side platforms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct and administrative costs allowable under Circular 78/2014/TT-BTC and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP, excluding non-deductible items such as fines, excessive entertainment expenses above the 30% statutory cap on total deductible promotional and entertainment costs, and provisions not meeting legal conditions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border management fees and service charges are deductible only if supported by valid contracts, evidence of actual service provision, and transfer pricing compliance documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income calculated after statutory adjustments for non-deductible expenses, tax-exempt income, and loss carryforward utilisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward deductions are limited to 5 years and must be tracked separately at the Vietnamese legal entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable headline or preferential rate: standard 20% or preferential 10% for high-tech/software enterprises if certified.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must have retained the approved preferential tax certificate permanently in the tax file for any reduced rate claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate of quarterly provisional CIT payments already made under Form 01/TNDN during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-invested LLCs must monitor cash flow to ensure quarterly instalments are at least 80% of the final liability to avoid penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction schedule (Form 01/PLI-TNDN or equivalent) identifying all cross-border transactions with related parties by category, value, and pricing methodology.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent entities must ensure the Vietnamese LLC submits full TP forms with contemporaneous documentation; transactions with ad-exchange affiliates in low-tax jurisdictions are highest scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties: 10-15% of the tax amount due for late submission within 90 days; 20-30% for 90-365 days; 30-50% for over 365 days depending on the amount of tax due. Additional interest on overdue tax is 0.03% per day on the unpaid amount. Failure to register or electronic filing is subject to administrative fines up to VND 35 million per violation, and a director who willfully omits tax obligations may face criminal tax evasion charges.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: The domestic corporate income tax of 20% already applies at the LLC level; dividends paid by a Vietnamese LLC to foreign shareholders are generally not subject to an additional Vietnamese dividend withholding tax where the dividend is derived from after-CIT profits. However, branch remittance profits of foreign-owned branches are subject to an additional 0.0% to 5.0% branch profit remittance tax, and constructed dividend rules may apply in certain limited circumstances.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where a separate withholding tax or deemed dividend regime arises, the foreign shareholder must invoke relief under the Vietnam-DTA (e.g., Vietnam-Singapore, Vietnam-Hong Kong, or Vietnam-China tax treaty) by: (1) obtaining a valid Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from the shareholder's home jurisdiction tax authority; (2) submitting the TRC and an application form to the Vietnamese tax authority before or at the time of the remittance; (3) providing evidence of beneficial ownership and substantive business activity of the shareholder; and (4) awaiting approval before reduced withholding is applied. If DTA relief is not approved, the domestic statutory rate applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates: royalties and technical service fees are subject to CIT withholding at 10% under domestic law, applied as a combined foreign contractor tax rate (typically 10% CIT plus value added tax at the applicable rate, commonly referred to as the foreign contractor withholding tax); interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to 5% CIT withholding. Under applicable DTAs, royalty rates are commonly reduced to 5-10% and interest to 5-10% depending on the treaty partner and beneficial ownership conditions. A Vietnamese LLC in the ad-tech sector importing DSP/SSP software licences or paying platform access royalties to foreign affiliates must withhold foreign contractor tax at the domestic rate absent a valid treaty reduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Prepared Local File and Master File are mandatory if the taxpayer has related-party transactions above VND 30 billion per year, or if the taxpayer's related-party transaction value exceeds 50% of total revenue, or where the total related-party revenue exceeds 50% of total operating expenses. Even below those thresholds, a Vietnamese TP declaration form and contemporaneous documentation may be required on a risk-based basis. Country-by-Country Report thresholds follow Decree 132/2020/ND-CP for groups with consolidated revenue above VND 18 trillion.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam applies Economic Substance rules via Decree 132/2020/ND-CP requiring that controlled transactions reflect actual commercial substance, that the entity bears genuine risks and functions, and that profits are commensurate with the value-creation activities undertaken in Vietnam. A Vietnamese LLC acting as a commissionaire or low-risk distributor for group ad-tech functions, with minimal employees, offices, and decision-making, is exposed to recharacterisation, profit adjustment back to Vietnamese substance, and a mandatory 8% interest levy on any tax adjustment. Formal Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as applied in UAE/Caribbean jurisdictions do not exist under Vietnamese law, but the doctrine of substance is embedded in TP audit practice and anti-avoidance legislation in Decree 132.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion by Offshore Revenue Diversion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing programmatic advertising revenue through a foreign shell intermediary without real operational substance, understating Vietnamese-source income, using artificial invoicing for technology services, or failing to declare revenue generated from Vietnamese users and advertisers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of up to 3 times the evaded tax amount under the Tax Administration Law 38/2019/QH14, plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; criminal liability for tax evasion exceeding VND 100 million (or VND 300 million with aggravating factors) may result in imprisonment from 6 months to 3 years, or up to 7 years where the evaded amount is exceptionally large.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives may be jointly and severally liable for tax debts incurred during their tenure; deliberate evasion can trigger personal criminal liability, civil restitution of the corporate veil, travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and up to 7 years of imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Misdeclaration and Documentation Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting intercompany ad exchange fees, data management fees, or DSP/SSP commission rates outside the arm's length range, or failing to submit the Local File, Master File, and CBCR within the prescribed deadline.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment with upward taxable income correction plus interest at 0.03% per day; administrative penalty of 20% of the adjusted tax underpayment plus late-payment interest. Failure to submit documentation may trigger a penalty of 20% of the tax due and a fixed fine of up to VND 25 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Vietnamese tax authorities may issue demands on directors and legal representatives where the company is dissolved or insolvent without paying adjusted TP liabilities; deliberate TP manipulation with intent may be pursued as tax evasion with imprisonment up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Structure and Sham Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating the Vietnamese LLC in form but delegating all decision-making, risk retention, ad-tech operational activity, and strategic control to a Hong Kong or Singapore parent with no meaningful Vietnamese office, staff, financial records, or board activity, allowing profits to be allocated offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP with profit adjustment; Interest on adjusted tax at 0.03% per day; administrative fines up to VND 35 million for accounting irregularities; potential criminal tax fraud where manipulated substance facilitates revenue concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal disqualification from serving as legal representatives, travel restriction orders, and criminal prosecution for intentional falsification of corporate records; the corporate veil may be pierced to recover unpaid tax from personal accounts in a deliberate evasion scheme.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating programmatic ad exchange cash flows without customer due diligence, conducting wire transactions in cash or through suspected intermediary accounts, transacting with sanctioned Russian or Iranian ad networks, or failing to report large cross-border transfers under Vietnam AML Law and State Bank of Vietnam requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative sanctions under AML Law 2022: fines up to VND 300 million for AML compliance failures and a temporary suspension of corporate registration up to 3 months for serious violations; transfers to sanctioned jurisdictions can trigger trade control penalties and designated entity freezing, custom cooperation sanctions and referral to the Ministry of Public Security for criminal notices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managers and compliance officers face personal fines, travel bans, and criminal liability for willful participation in laundering criminal property or violating international sanctions with penalties including imprisonment up to 10 years and personal financial restitution.
